name: Govee
instructions: Sign in to Govee, open the API or Developer settings, and create a personal API key in the Govee Home app → About Us → Apply for API Key. Copy it and paste it into Warthog here — it is stored encrypted and is never shown again. For the exact steps, see the provider's documentation at https://developer.govee.com/reference/apply-you-govee-api-key.
